examples.en: Module federation lets independently deployed apps share components at runtime.
examples.zh: 模块联邦让独立部署的应用在运行时共享组件。

situation.en: We use module federation so each team ships its shell piece on its own cadence.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 模块联邦（运行时共享远程模块）

examples.en: Build orchestration rebuilds only what a change actually touches.
examples.zh: 构建编排只重建一次变更真正触及的部分。

situation.en: With build orchestration, the monorepo builds in dependency order and caches the rest.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 构建编排（安排多包多应用的构建顺序）

examples.en: An incremental build turns a ten-minute pipeline into ninety seconds.
examples.zh: 增量构建把十分钟的流水线变成九十秒。

situation.en: The incremental build keys off content hashes, not timestamps.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 增量构建（只重建变化的部分）

examples.en: A code splitting strategy balances first load against click delays.
examples.zh: 代码分割策略要在首屏加载和点击延迟之间找平衡。

situation.en: Our code splitting strategy splits by route first, then by heavy component.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 代码分割策略（决定哪些代码拆成懒加载块）

examples.en: Route-level splitting keeps rarely visited pages out of the main bundle.
examples.zh: 路由级拆分把不常访问的页面挡在主包之外。

situation.en: Route-level splitting alone cut the initial bundle by a third.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 路由级拆分（按页面拆包）

examples.en: The bundle budget fails CI when a pull request bloats the entry.
examples.zh: 包体积预算会在 PR 把入口撑大时让 CI 失败。

situation.en: We set a bundle budget per route and review breaches like test failures.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 包体积预算（给 bundle 大小定的红线）

examples.en: Dead code elimination works best with pure, side-effect-free modules.
examples.zh: 死代码消除在模块纯净、无副作用时效果最好。

situation.en: One side-effectful import quietly disabled dead code elimination for the whole library.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 死代码消除（构建期删掉用不上的代码）

examples.en: A compound component lets tabs and panels coordinate without prop drilling.
examples.zh: 复合组件让选项卡和面板不用层层传 props 就能配合。

situation.en: I model the accordion as a compound component with context doing the wiring.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 复合组件（父子配合、共享隐式状态的组件模式）

examples.en: Form state management decides what lives in the form library versus the page.
examples.zh: 表单状态管理决定什么放表单库、什么放页面。

situation.en: Good form state management keeps validation close to the field it judges.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 表单状态管理（校验、脏状态、提交的管法）

examples.en: State normalization stores each entity once, keyed by id.
examples.zh: 状态规范化把每个实体按 id 只存一份。

situation.en: State normalization ended the three-copies-of-the-same-user bugs.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 状态规范化（按 id 存实体、引用代替嵌套）

examples.en: Optimistic UI makes likes feel instant on slow networks.
examples.zh: 乐观界面让点赞在慢网络下也像即时的一样。

situation.en: We use optimistic UI for reactions, never for payments.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 乐观界面（先更新界面、失败再回滚）

examples.en: A sync engine queues local writes and reconciles them with the server.
examples.zh: 同步引擎把本地写入排队，再与服务器对账。

situation.en: Our sync engine treats the server log as truth and the local store as a cache.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 同步引擎（本地优先应用的数据同步层）

examples.en: Client-side conflict resolution merges two offline edits of one document.
examples.zh: 客户端冲突解决合并同一文档的两份离线编辑。

situation.en: For text we chose last-writer-wins client-side conflict resolution and logged the loser.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 客户端冲突解决（离线编辑撞车后的合并）

examples.en: Virtual DOM diffing compares trees to patch only what changed.
examples.zh: 虚拟 DOM 对比通过比较两棵树，只修补变化的部分。

situation.en: Keys exist so virtual DOM diffing does not confuse siblings after a reorder.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 虚拟 DOM 对比（找出最小真实更新）

examples.en: The fiber architecture lets React pause and resume rendering work.
examples.zh: Fiber 架构让 React 能暂停和恢复渲染工作。

situation.en: Under the fiber architecture, urgent updates can interrupt a long render.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: Fiber 架构（React 的可中断渲染引擎）

examples.en: Partial hydration wakes only the interactive islands on the page.
examples.zh: 部分水合只唤醒页面上可交互的岛。

situation.en: Partial hydration shipped the article as static HTML with two live widgets.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 部分水合（只激活页面上需要的岛）

examples.en: The islands architecture keeps most of the page as plain HTML.
examples.zh: 岛屿架构让页面大部分保持纯 HTML。

situation.en: We picked the islands architecture for the marketing site: static by default.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 岛屿架构（静态页里嵌独立交互岛）

examples.en: Resumability restores interactivity without re-executing the framework code.
examples.zh: 可恢复性让页面不重跑框架代码就能恢复交互。

situation.en: Qwik's resumability serializes listeners so the browser picks up where the server left off.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 可恢复性（不重跑代码、从序列化状态接续）

examples.en: Isomorphic rendering shares components between server and browser.
examples.zh: 同构渲染让组件在服务器和浏览器之间共享。

situation.en: Isomorphic rendering pays off only if the team respects the environment split.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 同构渲染（同一套代码在服务端和客户端跑）

examples.en: Edge rendering cuts the distance between user and first byte.
examples.zh: 边缘渲染缩短了用户与第一个字节之间的距离。

situation.en: Edge rendering helped overseas users most; local users barely noticed.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 边缘渲染（在靠近用户的边缘节点渲染）

examples.en: A data fetching waterfall chains requests that could have run in parallel.
examples.zh: 数据获取瀑布把本可并行的请求串成了链。

situation.en: The fix for a data fetching waterfall is to start fetches higher and earlier.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 数据获取瀑布（串行等数据的链式延迟）

examples.en: Request deduplication collapses simultaneous identical calls into one.
examples.zh: 请求去重把同时发生的相同调用合并成一次。

situation.en: Request deduplication at the data layer killed a third of our API traffic.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 请求去重（相同请求合并成一次）

examples.en: Every cache invalidation strategy is a bet about how data changes.
examples.zh: 每种缓存失效策略都是在赌数据会怎么变。

situation.en: Our cache invalidation strategy is boring on purpose: short TTL plus explicit purge on writes.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 缓存失效策略（决定缓存何时过期或清除）

examples.en: Critical CSS is inlined so the first paint never waits on a stylesheet.
examples.zh: 关键 CSS 被内联起来，首屏绘制不用等样式表。

situation.en: Extracting critical CSS moved first paint ahead by half a second.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 关键 CSS（首屏需要的最小样式集）

examples.en: Resource hints tell the browser what it will need next.
examples.zh: 资源提示告诉浏览器接下来会用到什么。

situation.en: Resource hints help when they name the real bottleneck, not everything.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 资源提示（预连接、预加载这类浏览器暗示）

examples.en: A forced reflow happens when code reads layout right after changing it.
examples.zh: 强制同步布局发生在代码改完样式立刻又读布局的时候。

situation.en: The animation jank traced back to a forced reflow inside the scroll handler.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 强制同步布局（读布局属性逼浏览器立刻排版）

examples.en: Everything visual waits on the main thread.
examples.zh: 所有视觉相关的事都要等主线程。

situation.en: The main thread was busy for four seconds parsing one bundle.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 主线程（浏览器跑 JS 和渲染的线程）

examples.en: A web worker keeps heavy parsing off the main thread.
examples.zh: Web Worker 把重解析挪离主线程。

situation.en: We moved syntax highlighting into a web worker; typing stayed smooth.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 后台线程（在主线程之外跑重计算）

examples.en: The compositor thread can scroll even while the main thread is stuck.
examples.zh: 合成线程能在主线程卡住时继续滚动。

situation.en: Transform and opacity animate on the compositor thread, which is why they stay smooth.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 合成线程（负责图层合成与滚动）

examples.en: Task scheduling yields to the browser between chunks of work.
examples.zh: 任务调度在工作块之间给浏览器让路。

situation.en: With explicit task scheduling, the long import stopped freezing the page.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 任务调度（把长任务切开让路给交互）

examples.en: The service worker lifecycle explains why updates wait for tabs to close.
examples.zh: Service Worker 生命周期解释了为什么更新要等标签页关闭。

situation.en: Skipping the waiting phase in the service worker lifecycle ships updates faster but riskier.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: Service Worker 生命周期（安装、激活、接管）

examples.en: A cache-first strategy serves the shell instantly and refreshes quietly.
examples.zh: 缓存优先策略立刻给出外壳，再悄悄刷新。

situation.en: Static assets use a cache-first strategy with hashed filenames.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 缓存优先策略（先查缓存、没有再联网）

examples.en: A network-first strategy keeps content fresh with a stale fallback.
examples.zh: 网络优先策略保持内容新鲜，失败时再用旧的顶上。

situation.en: The news feed uses a network-first strategy; the shell uses the opposite.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 网络优先策略（先联网、失败再用缓存）

examples.en: Background sync retries queued actions when connectivity returns.
examples.zh: 后台同步在网络恢复后重试排队的操作。

situation.en: With background sync, a review written on the train posts itself at the station.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 后台同步（联网恢复后补发离线操作）

examples.en: The content-visibility property lets the browser skip offscreen subtrees.
examples.zh: content-visibility 属性让浏览器跳过屏外子树的渲染。

situation.en: One line of content-visibility made the long report page scroll smoothly.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 内容可见性（跳过屏外内容渲染的 CSS 属性）

examples.en: A view transition animates between states without a router hack.
examples.zh: 视图过渡让状态之间平滑动画，不用在路由上做手脚。

situation.en: The view transition made list-to-detail navigation feel native.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 视图过渡（页面状态间的平滑动画 API）

examples.en: Prerendering builds the next page before the user clicks.
examples.zh: 预渲染在用户点击之前就把下一页建好。

situation.en: Speculation-driven prerendering made article navigation feel instant.
situation.zh: 你在优化首屏性能时这样解释：

entries.zh: 预渲染（提前把页面渲染好等用户点）

examples.en: Speculative loading spends bandwidth to buy certainty about the next click.
examples.zh: 推测加载花带宽来买下一步点击的确定性。

situation.en: Speculative loading rules let the browser prerender likely next pages safely.
situation.zh: 面试官深挖前端架构，你回答：

entries.zh: 推测加载（预测下一步并提前加载）

examples.en: Local state should stay local until two distant components need it.
examples.zh: 本地状态应该一直留在本地，直到两个相距甚远的组件都需要它。

situation.en: Most of what teams globalize is really local state with ambition.
situation.zh: 技术评审上聊前端方案，你这样说：

entries.zh: 本地状态（只属于组件自己的状态）
